artworks.title: Isaac Hilary
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust portrait, from the chest up. He is turned slightly to his right and looking directly at the viewer. The man has a mustache, beard, short hair, and a ruffled collar. He wears a patterned garment with decorative elements. The background features an oval frame around the man, and text within the border reads "NOBILIS VIR ISACO HILARIO DNS IN RIVIERE A.1613."

artworks.title: Arthur Hildersham, Minister
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man sitting at a table. He faces forward with his body slightly turned to the left, resting both arms on a cushioned surface. The man has an aged appearance with a short beard and mustache, closely cropped hair, and wears a ruffled collar and a dark garment with puffy sleeves. In front of him is an open book, with his left hand pointing to a page and his right hand raised in a gesture. The background features an intricately patterned panel and a shield emblem on the right side, indicating a formal setting, likely an indoor study or office.

artworks.title: Philip, Count of Hohenlohe
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man with a defined face, pointed beard, mustache, short curly hair, wearing a dark coat and large ruff. The background includes a circular frame with an inscription and Latin text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Thomas Holland, Regius Professor of Divinity at Oxford, and Rector of Exeter College
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body, slightly positioned to the right with his head turned towards the front. The man has pronounced facial features, a full beard that merges with a mustache, and wears a soft, rounded cap. He is dressed in period clothing with a ruffled collar and a flowing garment over his shoulders. The background has vertical lines, and below the portrait is an inscription that reads "THOMAS HOLLANDVS" and some Latin text.

artworks.title: Thomas Holland, Jesuit
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body. The man stands with his body slightly turned, facing the viewer with a direct gaze. He has a mustache and wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is wearing a high-collared garment with a robe or cloak on his shoulders. One hand is raised, holding a crucifix emitting radiant lines with the initials "IHS" nearby, while the other hand appears to hold a small, circular object. The background includes architectural elements like brickwork and a column, with foliage visible on the left side.

artworks.title: Joanni Hollando (Jan Hollander)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He has a serious expression on his face, broad facial features, and a short, curly beard. His hair is medium length and styled under a tilted beret. The man wears a coat with a fur collar over a simpler garment. In his hands, he holds an artist's palette and brushes. The background consists of parallel lines, and a Latin inscription is beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Sigismundus Jacobus Holtzschuher de Neuenburg
artworks.description: A portrait of an elderly man shown from the waist up. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his left hand resting on his hip and his right hand holding a walking cane. His facial features include a long face with prominent cheekbones and a pronounced nose. He has curly, shoulder-length hair that frames his face and a full head of hair. The man is wearing a dark-colored coat with buttons and a lace cravat at the neck. His sleeves are decorated with embroidery and lace cuffs. A sash is tied around his waist. The coat has buttons and decorative elements on the right side. The background shows an oval frame with an inscribed border, set against a textured surface. Above the frame sits a ribbon, and below is an ornate plinth featuring a heraldic crest with a shield and decorative scrollwork. The background details and text around the portrait provide formal context.

artworks.title: Head of a Man Crowned with Laurel: Homer
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a person featuring their head and shoulders. The individual faces slightly left with their head turned towards the viewer. They have strong facial features with a full beard and curly hair, decorated with a laurel wreath. The person is wearing textured clothing on their shoulder. The background is plain with scattered brownish spots on a light surface. There are no other objects or jewelry in the image.

artworks.title: Hendrik Hondius
artworks.artist: Frederick Bouttats II or Frederick Bouttats I after Hendrik Hondius I
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his right with his gaze directed toward the viewer. He has a mustache and pointed goatee. His hair is wavy and combed back. The man is dressed in a textured coat with a large collar and wide lapels. He holds a pair of compasses. In the background, there is a draped curtain to the left and a landscape view through an opening showing hills with buildings and vegetation. A column is partially visible to the right.

artworks.title: Jodocus Hondius
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated, facing left. The individual has a full beard, mustache, short hair, and wears a decorated jacket with a high lace collar and fur-trimmed mantle. They are holding a compass against a globe, with books and objects around them. In the background, a draped map of Europe and Asia is visible, labeled with names of places.

artworks.title: Johannes Hoornbeeck
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within composition): 21.6 × 12.6 cm (8 1/2 × 4 15/16 in.)
accessory (text block): 3 × 20.5 cm (1 3/16 × 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts the upper body of a man facing slightly to his right and looking directly at the viewer. He has a mustache, a small goatee, expressive eyes, and slightly tousled hair above his collar. He is wearing a dark jacket with buttons and a large white collar. The background features an intricately shaded pattern.

artworks.title: Petrus Hogerbeets Hornanus
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of an older man. His head is turned slightly, and his gaze is directed straight ahead. He has a beard, mustache, curly hair, and wears an elaborate ruffled collar and a dark, patterned garment. The portrait is surrounded by an oval border with inscribed text and a plain, hatched background.

artworks.title: Rumoldus Hogerbeets Hornanus
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Jan Anthonisz Ravesteyn
artworks.description: The image shows a bust of a man within an oval frame. He is facing the viewer with strong facial features, including a prominent nose and a full moustache. The man has close-cropped hair and a slight beard. He is wearing a detailed garment with a ruffled collar. The frame around him has inscriptions, and the background is dark. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Laurence Humphrey
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man with a beard and mustache, facing forward with his body slightly turned to his right. He wears a peaked cap, a high-collared garment with buttons, a ruff, and a cloak. In the background, there is a simple crosshatched pattern. Below the portrait, there is a plaque with the text "Laurentius Humfredus."

artworks.title: Laurence Humphrey, Dean of Winchester
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of Laurentius Humfredus, who is positioned facing slightly to the left. He has a full beard and mustache with hair styled neatly beneath a flat, broad-brimmed hat. He wears a collared garment featuring a ruffled edge around his neck and a doublet with detailed buttons running down the front. In one hand, he holds a closed book. The background features a scenic view of a coastline with a large ship sailing on the sea to the right and a hilly landscape on the left with buildings and possibly a church or tower perched atop the hill. The border below the portrait includes text with his name followed by several lines in Latin.

artworks.title: Lord Hundson, Henry Carey
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist upwards. He is facing slightly to his left with his gaze forward. He has a distinguished face with finely arched eyebrows, a prominent mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. He is wearing an elaborate hat with a wide band and a large plume. The man is dressed in a detailed outfit with a high, ruffled collar and an ornate front panel. The clothing features intricate patterns resembling brocade or embroidery. He wears a small brooch on his chest. The background consists of a simple oval frame emphasizing his figure, with no additional context or scenery.

artworks.title: Constantin Huygens
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is positioned slightly turned to the right, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a distinguished face with a sharp nose, a small mouth with a subtle smile, and a well-groomed mustache. His hair is wavy and dark, styled away from his face. He wears an elaborate garment adorned with detailed embroidery and a high, pleated ruff collar. The portrait is framed within an oval border, and below the portrait are handwritten script and engravings. The background features a simple crosshatched pattern, and above the portrait, the word "CONSTANTER" is inscribed in large, capital letters.

artworks.title: Isabella, Third Wife of Philip II of Spain
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in profile facing left. She has a high forehead and a sharp profile. Her hair is styled intricately with braids and jewels, and she wears a pearl headband. She wears an ornate dress with intricate patterns and textures, puffed sleeves, lace details, and a fitted bodice with decorative buttons. She holds a rose and wears a necklace. The background has a textured oval frame with inscriptions and fine horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Isabella, Wife of Philip IV of Spain
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait displaying a profile view of a woman from the chest up, positioned to the left. The woman has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and slightly open mouth, and her hair is styled in tight curls with adornments. She is wearing an intricate gown with ornamental patterns around the neckline and a cross-shaped pendant around her neck. The portrait is set within an ornate frame decorated with swirling motifs, masks, and mythical creatures. The background is filled with intricate line work and decorative elements. The words “ISABELLA V. ÁLESTA DI SPAGNA REGINA” encircle the image.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia, Infanta
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman from the waist up, positioned centrally within an ornate circular frame. She has an elaborate hairstyle, with her hair pulled up into intricate curls and adorned with a decorative headpiece. Her facial features are detailed, with a neutral expression and large eyes. Around her neck is a large, ruffled lace collar, and she is dressed in a richly patterned garment with a high neck and puffed sleeves. She wears a prominent earring. The circular frame includes an inscription and at the top, two birds are depicted facing each other. The background features floral motifs on either side of the frame. Below the portrait is an area with Latin text engraved into the plate.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenie
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of a woman shown from the waist up. She is positioned facing forward with her head turned slightly to her left. Her facial features are finely detailed, with a composed expression, arched eyebrows, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo adorned with intricate ornamentation. She is wearing an opulent dress with lavish detailing, including a large lace ruff encircling her neck, and her sleeves are richly decorated. She also wears earrings. The surrounding frame of the image is oval and contains additional decoration, such as floral and foliage motifs, with text encircling the frame. The background is textured with diagonal lines, and two birds are positioned at the top corners.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenia, Infanta
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up. Her hair is intricately styled with decorative elements on top. She has a serene expression with soft facial features, slightly arching eyebrows, and a direct gaze. She is dressed in elaborate clothing typical of the period, featuring a high lace ruff collar, richly embroidered fabric, and accessories like a detailed brooch and a string of beads or pearls. The background features a simple, textured circular frame with inscriptions identifying her as "ILLUSTRISSIMA ISABELLA AUSTRIACA." An ornate Latin inscription is present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenie of Austria, Spain and Countess of Flanders
artworks.artist: Paul de la Honne after Karel van Mallery
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is positioned slightly angled to the viewer, with her face turned towards the front. Her expression is neutral, with fine eyebrows, a straight nose, and closed lips. Her hair is styled in an elaborate high updo, adorned with decorative elements or fabric. The woman is wearing ornate clothing with intricate patterns and embellishments, including a large lace ruff around her neck and a necklace with a large pendant. The background of the portrait is a simple, textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Isabella Clara Eugenie of Spain, Archduchess of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman within an ornate oval frame. She has a topknot hairstyle with a decorative plume and a ruffled collar. The frame includes various figures and motifs, such as seated women, a putto with a bird, and animals and floral designs. Latin inscriptions surround the frame, with elegant scrollwork in the lower section.
